survey: A round wall clock seen straight on, flat against a striped green wall. A thick, glossy orange ring frame holds a flat white dial. The dial has 12 navy hour bars, one at each hour position, and a ring of small navy dots for the minutes. Three hands share one central hub with a red cap: a short, thick hour hand pointing at about 10, a longer navy minute hand pointing at 2, and a thin red second hand pointing toward 5 with a short tail past the hub. All the hands are stacked on the hub and none go through the frame. The frame is evenly round and the dial sits evenly inside it. The clock casts a soft shadow onto the wall, so it reads as hanging flat on the wall rather than floating.
